'''krazy_cheetah Watto's 5 Finger Force Loss''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[krazy_cheetah]]
* '''Published:''' 27 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif|label=No Money, No Parts, No Deal!}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 NMNPND krazy cheetah DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Reegesk (V) (Virtual Set 3), Ket Maliss (V) (Virtual Set 3), Blaster Rack (V) (Virtual Set 1): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

This is my first attempt at this deck but it can be a beast my opponent loses 3 force bfore they can even activate and all kinds of things get played for free.

== Notes ==

* Posted 'Tatooine (Coruscant)' dested Tatooine; the '(Coruscant)' presumably names the set printing.
* Posted Darth Maul (unmarked) dested the printed Darth Maul; Xizor dested Prince Xizor; Maul's Double Blade dested Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber; Maul's Infiltrator dested Maul's Sith Infiltrator; Ghhhk Combo dested Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us.
* Original-era (V) cards: Ket Maliss (V) and Reegesk (V) (Virtual Set 3), Blaster Rack (V) (Virtual Set 1).

== Strategy ==

Ok this deck is pretty basic. Turn 1 before I activate I pull Executor and Reegesk. Then if I didn’t draw Search and Destroy I lose Mob points to pull it. Ok activate. If I have Watto in hand I drop him to the junkyard, if not then I use the junkyard to pull him, then I drop Reegesk to Mos Espa, this flips my objective. I use Ket Maliss to drop a docking bay and do the best I can to back up Reegesk. Ok the last thing I do during my deploy phase is use my objective to bluff out something causing my opponent to lose 2 force. They then lose 1 more during my draw phase from Search and Destroy. That’s 3 force before they can do anything about it. From there it is pretty much battles and drains and bluffing whenever I can. I have Dathcha in case my opponent holds back 2 force and I want them to use it.
